coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

behavior.input_fields: first field at 0(rdi) is the length, second field at 8(rdi) is passed through in rdx
behavior.doubled_length: lea (rsi, rsi, 1) doubles the length field
behavior.clamp: count = doubled length if doubled length >= 5 else 4
behavior.call_arguments: rdi = stack out-slot, rsi = original length, rdx = second input field, rcx = count, r8d = element size
behavior.flag_arm: out-slot flag == 1 takes the indirect-call arm, else out-slot pointer is stored at 8(rbx) and count at (rbx)
behavior.padding: two int3 bytes follow each window before the next FDE start

claim: two near-identical windows differing only in element size
